top_insights: Growing scrutiny of AI safety evaluation practices suggests the industry is questioning whether current third-party assessors have adequate expertise for high-stakes safety analyses.
LLM security is becoming a mainstream bug bounty focus, with platforms like YesWeHack developing dedicated training curricula for vulnerability researchers.
AI security governance is maturing as a distinct professional discipline, evidenced by dedicated conference tracks and aggregated educational resources.
There appears to be a gap between the importance of AI safety work and the maturity of organizations being contracted to perform it.
